_doc: People for the circus, made like art/v2/insan/characters.json (MakeHuman MPFB, CC0 system assets) and posed still by art/v2/sirk/pose.py. The catcher wears no garment: pose.py paints his trunk and legs as a red leotard and his hands and wrists chalk white. The spectators are the crowd people of characters.json (crowd_man_casual, crowd_woman_b), seated.
